'''''The History of Two People, One Planet''''' was a publication authored by [[Theosidicc Sirrap Treblif]] and published by [[Elomin Press]]. It detailed the shared history of the [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] and [[Elom/Legends|Elom]] peoples.
